title: President Emílio Garrastazu Médici signs a law that establishes the Brazilian Civil Procedure Code.
text: Emílio Garrastazu Médicisi]; 4 December 1905 – 9 October 1985) was a Brazilian military leader and dictator who was the 28th president of Brazil from 1969 to 1974. His authoritarian rule marked the apex of the Brazilian military regime.

title: Emerson Fittipaldi wins the 1973 Brazilian Grand Prix at Interlagos.
text: Emerson Fittipaldi is a Brazilian former racing driver and motorsport executive, who competed in Formula One from 1970 to 1980. Fittipaldi won two Formula One World Drivers' Championship titles, in 1972 and 1974 with Lotus and McLaren, respectively; he won 14 Grands Prix across 11 seasons.

title: The president of Petrobras, General Ernesto Geisel, is selected as a candidate for President of Brazil.
text: Petróleo Brasileiro S.A., better known by and trading as the portmanteau Petrobras, is a Brazilian majority state-owned multinational corporation in the petroleum industry, which is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. The company's name translates to Brazilian Petroleum Corporation.

title: Varig Flight 820 makes a forced landing due to a fire breaking out and then crashing in Paris, France. 123 out of the 134 people are dead from the crash, fire, and smoke inhalation.
text: Varig Flight 820 was a scheduled flight of the Brazilian airline Varig that departed from Galeão International Airport in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, on 11 July 1973, for Orly Airport, in Paris, France. The Boeing 707, registration PP-VJZ, made an emergency landing in onion fields about 5 km from Orly Airport, due to smoke in the cabin from a lavatory fire.
